scheme_name: State Marriage Assistance Scheme For Poor Girls
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a family holding an AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana) or PHH (Priority Households) ration card.
Applicant must not have previously received financial assistance for the same purpose under any other UT/Centrally Sponsored Scheme, especially the Ladli Beti Scheme.
Applicant can receive the benefit only once under this scheme.
Application must be submitted at least one month before the date of marriage.
Applicant must provide proof of marriage, proof of age, a copy of the AAY or PHH ration card, and an Aadhaar card.

The beneficiary girl must have passed the 8th standard or equivalent; school drop‑outs may still apply under specific guidelines for the financial years 2022‑2023 to 2024‑2025, after which a certificate of 8th‑standard completion becomes mandatory.
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of ₹50,000 transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account before marriage.
documents_required: Copy of AAY or PHH ration card
